title: 第3章 升级破邪木屋第4章 核主
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地
content_zh:
;;
下一秒。
在沈坤和沈鸢二人惊愕的眼神中，他们看到原本被大哥握在手中的黑树枝，竟然凭空消失在了空气中。
这是怎么回事！？
二人揉了揉眼睛，确认自己并没有看花眼，目光立即便直勾勾地看着沈易。
“大哥，你……”
沈易面色微凛，确认收集黑树枝之后，会凭空消失在他人视线中。
这一点务必要格外警醒，不能够在其他人面前随意施展。
不过，日后要是能有个储物袋什么的，倒是可以掩饰过去。
但储物袋极其稀有，整个黑山村，也就历代村长才能拥有。
是黑山村村长的身份象征。
“我觉醒了一个特殊天赋，能够制造出各类工具。”
沈易缓缓开口说道。
对于二位弟弟妹妹，他并没有刻意隐瞒。
毕竟之后他要升级【破邪木屋】，二人绝对会察觉到房屋变化。
而且，他现在行动能力有限，估计这段时间都得卧床休息。
只能够让弟弟妹妹暂且替代他的双手去做事了。
“特殊天赋？”
闻言，沈鸢的眼睛立即明亮起来，兴奋地问：“是像村长小儿子那样的天生牛力吗？”
村长的小儿子在黑山村是有名的天才，小小年纪就能够抬得动一千斤的石磨！

经过古籍判断，他是拥有天生牛力的天赋，未来成就正式修行者之后，实力会比同阶之人高出一大截！
现在听到自家大哥也觉醒了天赋，沈鸢二人顿时精神振奋。
“没错。”
沈易点点头，随即叮嘱二人道：“此事不要声张，切勿让外人知晓，否则我们兄妹三人可能会有麻烦上身。”
“我们知道的，爹娘一直教导我们，要低调行事。”沈坤面色认真应道。
“听村里人说世上有一种邪修，能够夺取他人天赋，为了大哥的安全，我们定然会死守秘密，无论如何也不会泄露一个字。小妹，你也须得记住了。”
“我知道的！”
沈鸢用力点头。
她虽然年纪小，但是从小想的东西便很多，心智比同龄人来要成熟不少。
三兄妹依偎在木屋中，弱小的他们早已经将彼此的心紧紧连在一起。
沈易看到二人这么懂事，心中放宽不少。
【已收集材料：阴魂木*1】
看到收集到的量才只有这么点，沈易皱了皱眉，尝试升级破邪木屋。
结果下一秒。
阴魂木的数量重新归零。
破邪木屋随之发生了轻微的变化。
【破邪木屋·0级（升级中110）】
content_en:

The next second.
In the shocked eyes of Shen Kun and Shen Yuan, they saw that the black branch originally held by the eldest brother disappeared into the air.
What's going on! ?
The two of them rubbed their eyes to make sure they were not being dazzled, and immediately looked straight at Shen Yi.
"Brother, you..."
Shen Yi looked slightly stern, confirming that after collecting the black branches, he would disappear from the sight of others.
You must be extra vigilant about this and cannot do it at will in front of other people.
However, if there is a storage bag or something in the future, it can be covered up.
But storage bags are extremely rare, and only the village chiefs of the entire Black Mountain Village can have them.
It is the status symbol of the head of Heishan Village.
"I have awakened a special talent that allows me to create all kinds of tools."
Shen Yi said slowly.
He did not deliberately hide anything from his two younger brothers and sisters.
After all, he will upgrade the [Evil-Destroying Wooden House] in the future, and the two of them will definitely notice the changes in the house.
Moreover, his mobility is now limited and he will probably have to stay in bed during this period.
He can only let his younger brothers and sisters take over his hands to do things for the time being.
"Special talent?"
Hearing this, Shen Yuan's eyes immediately brightened up, and he asked excitedly: "Is he as naturally powerful as the village chief's youngest son?"
The village chief's youngest son is a famous genius in Heishan Village. He can lift a thousand kilograms of stone mill at a young age!
Judging from ancient books, he is gifted with natural strength. When he becomes a formal practitioner in the future, his strength will be much higher than that of people of the same level!
Now that they heard that their eldest brother had also awakened his talent, Shen Yuan and the other two were immediately in high spirits.
"That's right."
Shen Yi nodded, and then told the two of them: "Don't make this matter public, and don't let outsiders know, otherwise the three of us brothers and sisters may get into trouble."
"We know that our parents have always taught us to keep a low profile." Shen Kun replied seriously.
"I heard from people in the village that there is an evil cultivator in the world that can steal other people's talents. For the safety of big brother, we will definitely keep it a secret and will not leak a word no matter what. Little sister, you must remember it too."
"I know!"
Shen Yuan nodded vigorously.
Although she is young, she has thought about a lot since she was a child, and her mind is much more mature than her peers.
The three brothers and sisters nestled in the wooden house. They were weak and had already connected each other's hearts tightly.
Shen Yi felt relieved when he saw that the two of them were so sensible.
[Collected materials: Ghost Wood*1]
Seeing that the amount collected was only this small, Shen Yi frowned and tried to upgrade the evil-breaking wooden house.
The result is the next second.
The number of ghost trees returns to zero.
The Evil-Breaking Wooden House underwent slight changes.
[Evil-Destroying Wooden House·Level 0 (upgrading to 110)]
